newsitem.title: FINLAND: REBUILDS FOCUS FOR FINVEST'S POYRY - CEO.
newsitem.headline: REBUILDS FOCUS FOR FINVEST'S POYRY - CEO.

text.p: Finnish capacitor and forestry engineering group Finvest has been systematically building its forestry consulting engineers' unit Jaakko Pyory group's rebuilds and main engineering sector, CEO Niilo Pellonmaa said.

"We have systematically tried to construct the rebuilds sector," he told a news conference on Tuesday when asked how Jaakko Poyry -- which has a European market share of 40 percent -- copes with the forest industry's sharp cyclicality.
Rebuilding engineering now accounts for about a quarter of Jaakko Poyry group's annual 1.25 billion markka revenue, while new projects account for another quarter.
The remaining half of the engineering and consulting operation is for other than the forest industry, Finvest's chief financial officer Teuvo Salminen said.

Pellonmaa also said the forest industry's business cycle does not have a very large impact on Finvest, and added that last year's downturn did not have a notable impact on the group, although the depression in the early 1990s did.
